purpose: Transparent external electrical anomaly mechanism evaluation, not the LightGuard H1 production detector and not streetlight field accuracy or fault probability.

input_contract.missing_value_rule: Do not impute signals; retain missingness mask and unavailable components.

required: common physical scale or documented common affine transform
phase_gate.on_failure: LG-S3 is UNAVAILABLE; do not calculate phase asymmetry, sequence components, or substitute score.
phase_gate.rms_only_limit: RMS magnitudes lack phase-angle information and cannot yield symmetrical components.

split_and_calibration.fit_partition: author training records excluding deterministic calibration records
split_and_calibration.calibration_partition: sha256(sample_id + ':v13-calibration') mod 5 == 0; if immutable sample_id is unavailable, use original author-train order shuffled by deterministic_seed with 80/20 fit/calibration allocation

label_access.test_partition: confirmatory only after immutable configuration seal

split_and_calibration.threshold_selection: Select calibration score percentile with highest binary balanced accuracy; ties choose higher threshold.
split_and_calibration.candidate_selection: Select highest calibration binary balanced accuracy; exact ties choose SC3, then SC2, then SC1. Comparator cannot replace selected Signal Core candidate.

preprocessing.sequence_order: Preserve source order; reject records without intact ordered sequence.
preprocessing.scale_floor: calibration fifth percentile of positive channel MAD values; channel unavailable if no positive calibration scale exists

normalization.fit_scope: Fit data-derived constants on fit partition only; record-local medians/MADs use only that record's non-label measurements.
normalization.source_normalized_data: Retain source normalization; do not infer inverse transforms; block physical phase comparison unless common-scale provenance passes.
normalization.component_rank_transform: Empirical percentile ranks fitted on calibration scores only with deterministic mid-rank ties.

LG-S1.name: meter-or-record-relative robust baseline deviation
LG-S1.mapping: All available source-native ordered numerical channels; meter-relative wording needs physical meter identity and history.

LG-S2.name: persistence and temporal accumulation
LG-S2.mapping: LG-S1 eligible channels with intact ordering.

LG-S3.name: phase-current magnitude asymmetry
LG-S3.mapping: Only contemporaneous documented A/B/C currents on common scale.
LG-S3.interpretation_ceiling: Phase-current asymmetry only; not negative/zero sequence, symmetrical component, or asset fault.

LG-S4.name: abrupt or structural change
LG-S4.mapping: Median robust residual across eligible channels in ordered time.

LG-S5.name: transparent multivariate evidence combination
LG-S5.mapping: Available LG-S1 through LG-S4 only with per-case component and availability retention.

SC2.definition: equal-weight mean of LG-S2 and LG-S3 calibration percentile ranks

SC3.eligibility: at least two LG components; phase-specific interpretation requires LG-S3

comparator.definition: maximum absolute ordinary z-score summarized by temporal 95th percentile

primary_metric.name: External MAD Binary Balanced Accuracy
primary_metric.pre_registered_success_criterion: SC3 is eligible AND External MAD Binary Balanced Accuracy(SC3) >= 0.70 AND External MAD Binary Balanced Accuracy(SC3) - External MAD Binary Balanced Accuracy(z-score comparator) >= 0.05
primary_metric.not_evaluable_rule: If SC3 eligibility fails, report NOT_EVALUABLE; do not substitute another candidate.
primary_metric.claim_boundary: A pass supports external labeled electrical anomaly mechanism discrimination only, never LightGuard streetlight accuracy, field recall, or fault probability.

immutable_post_confirmatory_rule.failure_handling: Report frozen result and limitation. Exploratory follow-up needs a new protocol identifier and cannot overwrite confirmatory result.
